game.title: Naija Ludo

game.tagline.text: Roll am, run am, and send dem go back yard!

game.howto.1.text: Tap di dice (or press Space) make e roll. If you roll 6, one seed go comot from yard enter your start square, and you go roll again.

game.howto.2.text: Tap one seed wey dey shine make e move as many squares as di dice show, go round di track clockwise. If you dey use keyboard, press 1 to 4, or arrow keys and Enter.

game.howto.3.text: If you land on one opponent seed wey dey alone, e go go back im yard, and you go roll again. Star squares and start squares safe, nobody fit catch you for there.

game.howto.4.text: If two or more of your seeds dey one square, na stack, dem no fit catch am. You fit change dis one for Rules.

game.howto.5.text: If you roll 6 three times one after di other, your turn don finish. Di third roll no count.

game.howto.6.text: Carry all your seeds reach home for di centre to win. You must roll di exact number to enter home. For Quick mode, you get 2 seeds and di first one wey reach home don win.

rules.title: Rules

rules.note.text: Di computer players dey follow di same rules wey you dey follow.

rules.capture.text: Extra roll if you catch person

rules.capture.help.text: Catch one opponent seed wey dey alone and you go roll again.

rules.exact.help.text: Seed must get di exact number to reach home. If you off am, any roll wey reach or pass home go work.

rules.three.help.text: If you roll 6 three times one after di other, di third roll no count.

rules.stacks.text: Seeds wey dey together (two or more)

rules.stacks.help.safe.text: Safe: dem no fit catch stack, and anybody fit share di square.

rules.stacks.help.block.text: Block: stack na wall. Nobody fit land on am or jump pass am.

rules.stacks.help.off.text: Off: no protection. If you land, you catch every opponent seed wey dey di square.

rules.quickFirst.text: Quick mode: first seed wey reach home don win

rules.quickFirst.help.text: For Quick mode, each side get 2 seeds. If you on am, di first seed wey reach home don win. If you off am, both go reach home.

rules.autoMove.text: Move di only seed for me

rules.autoMove.help.text: If only one move dey, make e move by itself, no ask me.

board.label.text: Ludo board wey get four yards and one home centre

play.yourTurn: Na your turn. Tap di dice make e roll.
play.rollAgain: Roll again o! Tap di dice.
play.pickSeed: You roll {n}. Tap one seed wey dey shine make e move.

play.autoMove.text: Only one move dey. Make we go!

play.forfeitYou.text: Three 6 o! Your turn don pass.

play.stuckYou: No seed fit move. Turn go pass.
